title: The Three-Stone
subtitle: Fifteen carats of Fancy Yellow. Set once, framed by two, never repeated.

stone.origin: A GIA-certified 15.24-carat Fancy Yellow cushion modified brilliant at center — natural color, even distribution, VS2 clarity, measuring 14.79 × 12.23 × 8.56 mm — flanked by a matched pair of Cadillac-cut diamonds in D-E color and IF-VVS2 clarity; the three-stone format chosen so that nothing competes with the center stone, and everything frames it.

description: A single Fancy Yellow cushion sits at the centre, its colour even and unhurried across the wide face. Two Cadillac-cut diamonds hold it from either side — clean, quiet, geometric — their white light throwing the warmth of the yellow forward. The three-stone form exists for one reason: to let the centre stone speak without competition. Everything around it is a decision about how to hold that colour, and nothing is asked to do more than frame it. Made to order in eighteen-karat yellow gold.
